messages:
harper: Heads-up — deploybot flagged a large migration touching user_events. Plan is staggered apply + row-level lock signaling during the midnight window. Need ops ack for 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC. @maria-db @olivia-sre

maria-db: Quick Q — what's the worst-case txn time per batch? Any deletes or large compactions?

harper: No deletes. We're adding nullable_col and backfilling in batched UPDATEs. Backfill uses ORDER BY id LIMIT 5000; fully naive run ~6–8h. We'll run rate-limited passes + 1% canary first.

sam-deploy: Can we add a deploybot gate that aborts the migration if PG lock wait goes >50ms for >1min? I can implement a health-check step to stop and revert the current batch.

deploy-bot: deploybot: migration job queued on prod-db-2. job_id=jb-2026-211999. Scheduled start 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC. Will emit LOCK_SIGNAL events to #incidents and post job updates here.

olivia-sre: I'll add a Prom alert (pg_lock_waiting_count > 100) -> page @oncall. Also adding a circuit-breaker hook to reduce concurrency when lock_waits spike.

joel: Rollback plan: if 95th latency increases >30% for >10m we stop and restore feature flag. Also we have a replica snapshot at 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z as a rollback point if needed.

maria-db: For backfill resumeability propose checkpointing every 200k rows into migration_progress. If aborted, resume from last checkpoint. SQL sketch:
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE user_events
SET new_col = compute(...)
WHERE id > :last_id
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 5000;
INSERT INTO migration_progress (migration, last_id, processed_at) VALUES ('add_new_col', :new_last_id, now());
COMMIT;
```

harper: Perfect. I'll update the runbook and release notes. Who wants to own the abort decision during the window? @olivia-sre?

olivia-sre: :thumbsup: I'll take on-call decisioning. I'll coordinate with @sam-deploy to flip the gate if needed.

harper: Also pinning service version to 3.2.1 for the window and documenting rollback steps in the PR. We'll run 1% canary traffic before full backfill.

sam-deploy: I'll add a dry-run flag to deploybot (`--check-locks-only`) to simulate early batches and report lock stats. Will post logs here.

deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled job jb-2026-211999 started (dry-run). Sample output:
```
batch 1: rows=5000 time=0.8s locks=small
batch 2: rows=5000 time=0.9s locks=small
simulated peak lock_wait=12ms
```
Looks safe for 1% canary.

harper: Locking checklist ✅. Merging migration PR now. I'll post a final go/no-go 30m before the window.
